desc.zh: 从半开区间的手算推导端点变化与扫描，求最大同时预订数。
desc.en: Derive endpoint changes and a sorted sweep to count simultaneous bookings.

complexity: O(b log b) time per book; O(b) space; O(B² log B) time for B calls

concepts.name: Endpoint sweep
concepts.description: Group changes at each time and accumulate overlap.

concepts.name: Half-open interval
concepts.description: Include the start and exclude the end.
